Primary maths topics

Number Bonds Games to 10 and 20.

Practise number bonds to 10 and 20, missing numbers and crossing ten. Clear pictures and worked steps support primary addition and subtraction.

Start maths practice

What are number bonds?

Number bonds are pairs that make a total. For example, 3 and 7 make 10. Knowing these pairs helps children calculate without counting every item.

Use bonds to cross ten.

For 8 + 5, split 5 into 2 and 3. First calculate 8 + 2 = 10, then 10 + 3 = 13.

Connect addition and subtraction.

If 3 + 7 = 10, then 10 − 3 = 7 and 10 − 7 = 3. Practise the related forms as well as the original sum.
